words: In addition, the study included older participants.
The plan is cheap; however, it takes time.
Many animals hibernate; for instance, bears.
Rents rose. As a result, fewer students stayed.
used to show an opposite point of view
Cars are fast; on the other hand, they pollute.
used to show a clear difference
In contrast, the second group improved.
used to report what a source says
According to the report, sales fell.
used to restate an idea more simply
Demand fell. In other words, fewer people bought.
Although it was late, she kept working.
used to give a logical conclusion
The test failed; therefore, we repeated it.
